shared_elements: shallow relief carving on a flat vertical face
possible eroded standing figures at the flanks of A vs frontal figure in B
justification: Both are upright rectangular monuments bearing shallow low-relief carving over a flat frontal face, and both are organised as a single tall panel, which is about as generic a correspondence as monumental carving offers. A's surface is filled with dense horizontal rows of small repeated incised signs (an inscription field), while B depicts a single frontal anthropomorphic figure with head, shoulders, arms, discs and pendant ornaments — no shared motif, posture, or attribute at all.
